Peach Melon Smoothie
By: Mateja ^_^
Published: Saturday, February 26, 2011 - 6:10pm

Ingredients




Ingredients:
3 cups honeydew melon, cubed and frozen
2 cups sliced peaches
1 cup orange juice
1 cup peach juice (or pineapple, if you don’t have peach juice
1 tablespoon honey

Preparation

1 Directions: 2 Put all the ingredients into a blender and mix until smooth. Fill into glasses and indulge!

About


This is a one step glass of simple deliciousness that can be served as a dessert, or breakfast too!
